svg.data-renderer: Matplotlib MathText / STIX; embedded vector paths
svg.title: A weighted graph and the spanning tree selected by Kruskal's algorithm
svg.desc: The left panel is a weighted graph on six vertices. The right panel shows the five edges of weights one, two, two, three, and four selected by Kruskal's algorithm.
Figure labels: Weighted graph; Kruskal tree; 2; 1; 4; 2; 3; 5; 6; 7; 8; 9; A; B; C; D; E; F; 2; 1; 4; 2; 3; A; B; C; D; E; F; Total weight 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 12
